title: Categories list shows the matrix, Default and one column per active tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, archived, so the list has an archived tier to leave out.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with no parts and no sales, on the General Matrix.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The columns read Category, Pricing Matrix, Default, then one column per active tier in number order.
  • Each tier header shows the tier's number and name; tier A's column is the last.
  • Category A is listed although it has no parts or sales.
  • Tier B has no column.
  • Uncategorized is the first row.
  • Category A's Pricing Matrix cell reads General Matrix with a Default badge.
